entities.summary: Shen Buhai was a Chinese statesman, reformer and diplomat. According to the Shiji, Shen Buhai served as Chancellor of the Han state under Marquis Zhao of Han, for around fifteen years to his natural death in office in 337 BC, ordering its government and doctrines emphasizing Shu 术 (administrative) technique, though the term is likely posthumous. According to Sima Qian, Shen Buhai was born in the central State of Zheng, serving as a minor official there.
